title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Car allowance: £6,000 per year

Location: London, WC2B 6SR

Working arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Employment type: Full-time

About the opportunity

Via is partnering with a leading UK homeware retailer looking for a Principal Data Engineer to lead the development of its cloud-first data platform.

You'll shape technical strategy, mentor senior engineers and build scalable data solutions supporting commercial, customer and operational decisions.

What you'll be doing
  • Lead the design and development of modern cloud data platforms and pipelines
  • Provide technical leadership, line management and mentoring to data engineers
  • Drive data architecture, engineering standards and best practices
  • Manage technical risks, delivery quality and platform performance
  • Optimise cloud infrastructure costs and data processing efficiency
  • Collaborate with product, engineering and data quality teams
What we're looking for
  • 6–8+ years' experience in data engineering, including technical leadership
  • Strong experience with Snowflake, Redshift or BigQuery (Snowflake preferred)
  • Hands-on AWS experience, including S3, Lambda, Kinesis, SQS or Firehose
  • Experience with dbt, Python or Node.js
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling skills
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitHub/GitLab and Terraform
  • Proven ability to mentor and manage technical teams

Experience with Power BI, ThoughtSpot, automated testing, cloud cost optimisation or vendor management would be advantageous.

Why apply?
  • £6,000 car allowance
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Hybrid working
  • Share save scheme
  • Additional employee benefits
  • Opportunity to shape enterprise-scale data engineering strategy
